name: Microgrid noncritical-load restoration request
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Requests a lower-priority load group when the documented resource margin is available.
description: Requests a lower-priority load group when the documented resource margin is available. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Restoration margin and group eligibility” at the input and “Noncritical-load reconnect request” at the output. Priority and power demand need current information.
